explanation.text:
NORDIC MINING ASA (org.nr 989 796 739) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2006-02-23, registered 2006-05-08. [brreg_enheter] Main industry (NACE 07.290): Bryting av ikke-jernholdig malm ellers. [brreg_enheter] Registered purpose: "Å drive leting etter mineraler og malmer, gruvevirksomhet, teknologiutvikling, virksomhet som måtte stå i forbindelse med dette, samt deltagelse i andre selskaper hvilket som helst sted i verden." [brreg_enheter] The company's website describes it as: "Exploration and production of high-end minerals and metals" [website] Wikipedia: "Nordic Mining ASA is an Anglo-Norwegian mining company based in Norway. Focussing on exploration and production of industrial minerals and metals, the company is primarily involved in rutile, quartz, and lithium. The company's shares are listed on Oslo Axess." [wikipedia] Business address: Munkedamsveien 45 oppgang A, Vika Atrium, 0250 OSLO. [brreg_enheter] Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Otto Søberg; board chair Kjell Roland; 4 other board members. [brreg_roller]

- Registered employees: 6 (as of 2026-04-10); 1 registered sub-unit. [brreg_enheter]

- Accounts on file for 2023, 2024, 2025.
